purpose: Hand-curated historical macro events used by scripts/seed-historical-regimes.mjs to bootstrap the analog backtester (PR B1.4). Each entry is a known, well-documented regime shift with a defensible severity rating. The list is intentionally small (12-15 events) — large enough to give the analog finder n>=3 matches for the common regimes, small enough that an analyst can audit every entry. Replace `severity_rationale` with primary sources before promoting any thesis card built on this data.

events.label: Lehman Brothers collapse
events.severity_rationale: Global financial crisis trigger; Nifty fell -38% over the next 90 days; FII outflow $14bn from India.

events.label: Demonetisation (India)
events.severity_rationale: Overnight cancellation of ₹500/₹1000 notes; Banking/NBFC/FMCG/Real Estate hit on liquidity squeeze.

events.label: GST rollout (India)
events.severity_rationale: Goods & Services Tax came into effect; short-term destocking by FMCG/Auto/Pharma supply chains.

events.label: COVID-19 circuit-breaker crash
events.severity_rationale: Lower-circuit hit on NSE; Nifty -38% in 30 days; lockdown announced 25-Mar; max-vol weeks in Indian market history.

events.label: COVID Delta 2nd wave peak
events.severity_rationale: Delta variant peak; oxygen crisis; sector rotation OUT of contact-services back INTO IT/pharma.

events.label: Russia invades Ukraine
events.severity_rationale: Brent crude +30% in 14 days; rupee weakened; Nifty Realty/Auto hit on input-cost shock; Defence rallied.

events.label: RBI surprise repo rate hike
events.severity_rationale: Off-cycle +40bps hike; Realty/Auto/NBFC hit; Banks (esp PSU) benefited on NIM expansion.

events.label: SVB collapse + global banking stress
events.severity_rationale: Silicon Valley Bank failed; contagion fears to mid-tier banks; Indian IT/Banks hit on cross-asset rotation; Defence/PSU Bank held up.

events.label: Israel-Hamas conflict begins
events.severity_rationale: Israel-Hamas war; Brent +10%; defence equipment names rallied; Auto/Aviation hit on fuel-cost concern.

events.label: Indian Lok Sabha election result (NDA reduced majority)
events.severity_rationale: BJP-led NDA returned but with reduced numbers; Nifty -6% intra-day on result; PSU/Defence/Capital Goods unwind; FMCG/Pharma stable.

events.label: India-Pakistan border tensions (Operation Sindoor)
events.severity_rationale: Cross-border military operation; FII risk-off rotation; Nifty Realty hit hardest (-12% in 14 days); Defence names rallied; Banking neutral.

events.label: Yen carry-trade unwind (global vol spike)
events.severity_rationale: BOJ hike + USDJPY rally triggered global carry unwind; VIX spiked; Indian IT/Banks hit on cross-asset rotation; recovered within 7-14 days.
